fixed_findings.proof: Concurrent requests for different account identifiers now use distinct singleflight keys.
Both test-push routes call LanzouMonitorService.send_test_event.
Idempotency events store a request fingerprint and return HTTP 409 for key reuse with a different payload.
The official report client rejects a blank request_id.
Request IDs are validated without lossy character replacement.
Client and server use the same canonical feature aliases.
Forward delivery exceeding 32 nodes raises an explicit error and does not truncate silently.
Server, schema and official client enforce shared delivery limits.
The official client enforces the response limit while streaming.
Read operations update last_checked_at without changing updated_at.
Every redirect target is revalidated, DNS is pinned to validated public addresses and response size is capped.
GroupGuard report writes require a write token or an operating-system-confirmed loopback connection.
SO1 manual login requires control authorization and is rate limited by a cooldown.
Upstream responses are read in bounded chunks.
Control audit logs use locking, rotation and tail reads.
So1Client is no longer a process-global singleton and retains per-instance configuration and synchronization primitives.
SO1 readiness validates authenticated session state instead of browser connection alone.
Blank and duplicate watcher IDs are rejected during configuration loading.
scan_on_start=false reports a warming state instead of degraded before the first scheduled scan.
Boolean, numeric and HTTP method configuration values are parsed strictly.
Diagnostics read configured ports, platform paths and current log names.
Internal API debugger requests forward the configured admin token.
Invalid Lanzou configuration is translated to HTTP 400 with a specific message.
Service takeover only terminates app.py processes inside the expected project root.
Persistence installation validates the candidate before stopping production and restores the previous service on failure.
NSSM archives must match a configured SHA-256 before execution.
Operations scripts use the current main_api log names and configurable paths.
Numeric environment variables use bounded typed parsers with explicit errors.
MySQL database names and character sets are restricted to validated allowlists.
Pinned dependencies were updated and pip-audit --strict reports no known vulnerabilities.
